# paloalto — 2023 high-value CVEs (CVSS>=7, CISA KEV, Exploit-DB, or SSVC exploitation active/poc)

Full records for all 35 paloalto CVEs of 2023 are in `data/cve/vendors/paloalto/2023.jsonl`.

### CVE-2023-0009 — GlobalProtect App: Local Privilege Escalation (PE) Vulnerability
- Assigner: palo_alto | Published: 2023-06-14 | Updated: 2024-12-30 | Max CVSS: 7.8
- CWE: CWE-807 CWE-807: Reliance on Untrusted Inputs in a Security Decision
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 7.8 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:L/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=no, Technical Impact=total

A local privilege escalation (PE) vulnerability in the Palo Alto Networks GlobalProtect app on Windows enables a local user to execute programs with elevated privileges.


**exploits:** Palo Alto Networks is not aware of any malicious exploitation of this issue.


**solutions:** This issue is fixed in GlobalProtect app 5.2.13, GlobalProtect app 6.0.5, GlobalProtect app 6.1.1, and all later GlobalProtect app versions.

Affected:
- Palo Alto Networks / GlobalProtect App: unaffected 6.2; affected 6.1 <6.1.1 (custom) changes:unaffected@6.1.1; affected 6.0 <6.0.5 (custom) changes:unaffected@6.0.5; affected 5.2 <5.2.13 (custom) changes:unaffected@5.2.13

Credits: Mohammad Arman from Zurich Insurance

References:
- https://security.paloaltonetworks.com/CVE-2023-0009

### CVE-2023-3285 — A BOLA vulnerability in POST /appointments in EasyAppointments < 1.5.0
- Assigner: palo_alto | Published: 2024-07-09 | Updated: 2024-08-02 | Max CVSS: 7.7
- CWE: CWE-639 CWE-639 Authorization Bypass Through User-Controlled Key
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 7.7 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:C/C:N/I:H/A:N`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=yes, Technical Impact=partial

A BOLA vulnerability in POST /appointments allows a low privileged user to create an appointment for any user in the system (including admin). This results in unauthorized data manipulation.

Affected:
-  / easyappointments: affected * <1.5.0 (git)
- alextselegidis / easyappointments: affected 0 <1.5.0 (git)

Credits: Ravid Mazon; Jay Chen

References:
- https://github.com/alextselegidis/easyappointments

### CVE-2023-6790 — PAN-OS: DOM-Based Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Vulnerability in the Web Interface
- Assigner: palo_alto | Published: 2023-12-13 | Updated: 2024-08-02 | Max CVSS: 8.8
- CWE: CWE-79 CWE-79 Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 8.8 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H`

A DOM-Based cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability in Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS software enables a remote attacker to execute a JavaScript payload in the context of an administrator’s browser when they view a specifically crafted link to the PAN-OS web interface.

**exploits:** Palo Alto Networks is not aware of any malicious exploitation of this issue.

**solutions:** This issue is fixed in PAN-OS 8.1.25, PAN-OS 9.0.17, PAN-OS 9.1.16, PAN-OS 10.0.12, PAN-OS 10.1.9, PAN-OS 10.2.4, PAN-OS 11.0.1, and all later PAN-OS versions.

Affected:
- Palo Alto Networks / PAN-OS: affected 8.1 <8.1.25 (custom) changes:unaffected@8.1.25; affected 9.0 <9.0.17 (custom) changes:unaffected@9.0.17; affected 9.1 <9.1.16 (custom) changes:unaffected@9.1.16; affected 10.0 <10.0.12 (custom) changes:unaffected@10.0.12; affected 10.1 <10.1.9 (custom) changes:unaffected@10.1.9; affected 10.2 <10.2.4 (custom) changes:unaffected@10.2.4; affected 11.0 <11.0.1 (custom) changes:unaffected@11.0.1; unaffected 11.1 <All (custom)
- Palo Alto Networks / Prisma Access: unaffected All
- Palo Alto Networks / Cloud NGFW: unaffected All

Credits: Palo Alto Networks thanks Kajetan Rostojek for discovering and reporting this issue.

References:
- https://security.paloaltonetworks.com/CVE-2023-6790
